boundaries.heading: # Two Pillars Don't Hold The Roof Up
boundaries.end_before: # What are you actually choosing together?
preserve_units: even a twin flame is one person; polarity does not make dyad sufficient; friends/community still matter

in Joel's relationships serious issues sent each partner to separate friend circles and created resentment about one-sided stories; exes may have breakup incentives; outside support stops being shared
partner cannot sanely be nearly all friendship/family/therapy/spiritual meaning plus practical survival infrastructure
some unusually strong couples may survive without community and weak individuals may still fail with community; community is not magic
mutual friends can notice patterns, comfort partner when Joel is wrong person to do it, and compare one-sided story with person they know
Joel strongly believes Bee and he would still be together with real community; community would have constrained demonization/baseless narcissistic-abuser accusations
friends could help Bee where Joel could not because she was projecting onto him
dyadic survival dependency can make BPD-like reactions more understandable because one person's flaws become existentially consequential

H. example: deepening relationship/outside shallowness increased dependency; nonmonogamy did not prevent possessiveness; demonization followed refusal to be possessed; separate friends affirmed one side
private/separate confidants can be necessary because partners need somewhere else to speak
confidants who do not know/like partner can become echo chambers and are automatically biased toward their friend
one shared confidant also has privacy/release-valve limits; no single arrangement solves everything
practical response: make community now, meetups, mutual/deep friendships, shared purpose, introduce old friends, mutualize friendships where possible, avoid completely separate social worlds
Joel believes romantic love can last a lifetime
boundaries.allowed_consolidations: The strong/weak-couple caveat and confidant tradeoffs may be stated more asymmetrically and briefly, but their substantive limits cannot disappear without owner approval.
